title: NOSTOS: CACHE-AWARE INFERENCE ROUTING
goal: After seeing this diagram, a technical reader should understand how Nostos derives modeled prefix affinity, combines it with backend health and inflight work, owns capacity through the response body, commits observations only after successful outcomes, and separates the data plane from prompt-safe operations telemetry.
audience: technical engineers operating OpenAI-compatible LLM inference fleets
format: 16:9 landscape, high resolution with four clearly separated horizontal lanes

lanes.label: 1 · REQUEST IDENTITY
flows: Client -> POST /v1/chat/completions -> 10 MiB bounded read -> routing envelope + original JSON bytes
routing envelope -> model + string messages + stream flag
role:content messages -> 64-byte chunks -> xxHash64 block sequence
model -> chat:<model> namespace
chat:<model> namespace + xxHash64 block sequence -> modeled prefix key

lanes.label: 2 · ROUTE DECISION + ADMISSION
flows: periodic /health probes -> healthy backend snapshot
modeled prefix key + bounded per-backend directory -> longest observed prefix per backend
healthy snapshot + prefix depth + inflight count + directory usage -> weighted scorer
no prefix anywhere -> least-inflight fallback -> selected backend
weighted scorer -> selected backend -> atomic TryReserve
TryReserve fails -> HTTP 429
TryReserve succeeds -> owned capacity slot

lanes.label: 3 · FAITHFUL PROXY + OUTCOME
flows: owned capacity slot + original JSON bytes -> preserve path + query + end-to-end headers -> inference backend
inference backend -> non-stream response status + body -> client
inference backend -> SSE body -> first response bytes -> flush chunks -> EOF -> client
non-stream status below 400 -> commit cumulative prefix observations
successful stream with response bytes -> commit cumulative prefix observations
connection error + 4xx/5xx + cancellation -> no commit
success + error + cancellation -> Release reservation

lanes.label: 4 · DIRECTORY, OPERATIONS + SCALE BOUNDARY
flows: commit cumulative prefix observations -> one backend-local namespace directory -> evict least recently observed key at capacity
route outcome -> sanitized bounded event ring -> /api/v1 overview + recent routes + Prometheus -> operator console
native engine token blocks + residency events -> stronger cache identity -> future directory reconciliation
multiple router replicas -> deterministic backend-group ownership -> aligned observation + routing

annotations: RED WARNING beside modeled prefix key: byte-block evidence, not engine KV truth
RED WARNING beside directory usage: metadata bound, not GPU cache capacity
At inference transport: 30 s response-header timeout; request context owns total stream lifetime
At event ring: stores backend, match counts, score, queue, status, stream mode, first-byte timing; never messages or raw block keys
At readiness: /livez means process alive; /readyz means at least one healthy backend
At current admission: selection happens before reserve; a lost race returns 429; reserve-during-selection is the next contract
loops: commit cumulative prefix observations -> bounded per-backend directory -> influences the next request lookup, labeled outcome-gated learning
exact_text: health first · locality ranks · reservation owns
footer: Nostos routes on bounded evidence: preserve likely prefill work, but never confuse an observation with engine truth.
output_doodles: a small client document at far left
three small GPU servers as the backend fleet
a tiny operator at the console in the final lane
avoid: claiming byte chunks are token blocks
claiming directory usage equals GPU memory
